title: GTA6 Eve: Push Square Launches October 2026 PS5 GOTM Poll
description: Push Square has launched its October PS5 Game of the Month poll. Following a manic September, October delivered a busy 31 days of releases right before GTA6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Month Before GTA6: October's PS5 Showcase

As the gaming community looks ahead to the monumental arrival of Grand Theft Auto VI, gaming outlet Push Square has officially kicked off its latest Game of the Month (GOTM) poll for October 2026.

October is perhaps best described by industry observers simply as "the month before GTA6." True to form, it proved to be an incredibly busy 31 days for new PS5 releases, following hot on the heels of an equally manic September. This back-to-back onslaught of new titles has made this latest GOTM poll all the more intriguing for players and critics alike.

## A Packed 31 Days of Releases

With developers and publishers looking to release their titles prior to the massive industry shift anticipated for GTA6, the past month has kept PS5 owners exceptionally busy. Compiling a definitive list of the best game from such a crowded window is no small feat, given the high volume of content that dropped over the 31-day period.

Players heading over to Push Square to cast their votes will find themselves deliberating over a diverse selection of candidates that managed to stand out amidst the pre-blockbuster rush.

## Editor's Take

It is fascinating to watch the gaming ecosystem hustle and bustle right before GTA6 completely alters the landscape. October's releases didn't just fill the time; they delivered memorable experiences in their own right, proving that PS5 maintained strong momentum leading into the final stretch.
